answer: Each newcomer plants a vine, stakes 70, and needs one sponsor vouch, sealed with a plume of work; each sponsor vouches for at most three. A delta auditor replays each plume; zero delta between newcomer and sponsor plume burns the bond, plus a 35 sponsor fine. Each fake costs 134: 44 fee, 70 bond, 20 share of a sponsor's 60 bond. 1,000 fakes cost 134,000 for a 40,000 pool: a rented-vine ring loses. An honest agent pays 44 once, keeping its bond.
